Research question: "What analyses or measurements would best test whether AP-1 acts as a cellular memory mechanism?"

Propose 5 distinct, concrete ideas (analyses, measurements, or experiments) that a research lab could pursue to address this question. For each idea give a short title and a description of one or two sentences.

ideas.title: "Perches in the soul" — residence-time vs. heritability mapping
ideas.description: Measure single-molecule chromatin residence times of FOS/JUN/JUNB by live-cell single-particle tracking and compare them to the persistence of the accessible sites those factors create (ATAC-seq time-chase over multiple divisions). Cellular memory requires the site to outlive the factor by orders of magnitude; matched timescales would instead indicate continuous driving rather than a stored mark.

ideas.title: "Sings the tune without the words" — accessibility decoupled from transcription
ideas.description: Run matched ATAC-seq, AP-1 CUT&RUN, and nascent transcription (PRO-seq/TT-seq) time courses far past stimulus withdrawal to find loci that stay open and AP-1-bound with no ongoing nascent output. A long silent-but-primed window that converts to faster, larger induction on restimulation is the signature of a latent memory element.

ideas.title: "Sweetest in the Gale" — second-hit amplification as the functional readout
ideas.description: Prime cells, wait, then re-challenge and quantify gains in response rate, amplitude, and the fraction of responding cells at candidate AP-1 memory loci. Show specificity by deleting the TRE motif or CRISPRi-silencing the individual primed enhancer, so that amplification is lost locus-specifically rather than only upon global AP-1 depletion.

ideas.title: "Sore must be the storm that could abash" — erasure threshold titration
ideas.description: Systematically titrate candidate memory erasers (cell-cycle arrest versus forced divisions, replication inhibition, p300/HDAC inhibition, BAF/SMARCA4 degron, H3.3 and histone-chaperone knockdown, AP-1 subunit degrons) to build a dose-by-duration map of what collapses primed accessibility. The identity and magnitude of the required insult discriminates replication-coupled, remodeler-dependent, and histone-variant-based memory mechanisms.

ideas.title: "Never asked a crumb of me" — maintenance without ongoing input
ideas.description: Use auxin/dTAG degrons to remove AP-1 protein completely after priming and test whether the primed, open state is maintained and still re-inducible without its founder factor. Combine with lineage-barcoded single-cell multiome (scATAC + scRNA) to test clonal heritability of the primed state across divisions, distinguishing a self-sustaining mark from one requiring continuous feeding.
